name: Falling Blocks

events.Click:
# Handle this designer control.
blocks_move(self, dx=-1)

# Handle this designer control.
blocks_move(self, dx=1)

# Handle this designer control.
blocks_move(self, rotate=True)

startup:
# Initialize the model and install keyboard shortcuts without executing external code.
self.timer = None
self.generation = 0
self.running = False
game_reset(self)
self.Board.bind('<Left>', lambda event: blocks_move(self, dx=-1))
self.Board.bind('<Right>', lambda event: blocks_move(self, dx=1))
self.Board.bind('<Up>', lambda event: blocks_move(self, rotate=True))
self.Board.bind('<Down>', lambda event: blocks_move(self, dy=1))
self.Board.bind('<space>', lambda event: blocks_drop(self))
self.Form1.protocol('WM_DELETE_WINDOW', lambda: game_close(self))
self.Form1.deiconify()
